task.description:
Start bpm-platform server for E2E tests. Port 8080 may be occupied by Docker Desktop.

Steps:
1. Run: netstat -aon | findstr :8080 — identify what is using port 8080
2. Attempt to start: Start-Job { zig-out/bin/bpm-platform } (if binary exists) OR zig build followed by start
3. If port 8080 is truly blocked by Docker Desktop: start on port 18080 with BPM_PORT=18080
   Then update BPM_TEST_URL to http://127.0.0.1:18080 for the E2E run
4. Wait for health check: curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/ready (or :18080 if alternate port)
5. Return PASS with the actual server URL when health check responds 200

Note: zig-out/bin/bpm-platform needs BPM_DB_URL, BPM_IDP_BASE_URL, BPM_KEYCLOAK_SECRET env vars from .env
Use: =postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev; http://127.0.0.1:8081=http://localhost:8081; =admin
acceptance_criteria: result.server_url contains the actual URL used

result.summary: bpm-platform server started on http://127.0.0.1:18080 (port 8080 occupied by bilimbaga-api-1 Docker container). DB at localhost:5432. Health check /health/ready returns HTTP 200 with db_latency_ms=2. BPM_TEST_URL must be set to http://127.0.0.1:18080 for E2E runs.

issues.description: .env BPM_DB_URL points to port 5442 (bilimbaga-db-1), but actual BPM database (my-fab-db-1) is at port 5432. Server started with corrected BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5432/bpm_dev.

result.next_action: E2E tests can now run with BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18080
